subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` become a supported public Plugin SDK operation for plugin-owned external lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The patch is technically strong, but tests cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants this permanent third-party compatibility contract rather than an internal or narrower Teams-specific seam.

options.title: Approve the generic public reset API
options.body: Accept the documented owner-coordinated contract and review the refreshed current-main merge result before landing.

options.title: Keep the reset internal
options.body: Refactor the Teams handler onto an owner-approved internal session service without adding a public Plugin SDK method.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Expose a smaller purpose-built lifecycle-boundary operation with fewer plugin-controlled metadata semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic public reset API
recommendation.body: Accept the documented owner-coordinated contract and review the refreshed current-main merge result before landing.
